lesson: The system is consistently attempting to front-run reversals against the dominant 4h/daily trend, leading to 'liquidity trap' entries where local Wyckoff distribution patterns are ignored in favor of minor timeframe sweeps. The high frequency of losses confirms that the strategy is failing to distinguish between genuine structural shifts and temporary volatility within a larger bearish trend.
adjustment: Implement a strict 'Trend Alignment Filter' that mandates all entries must align with the 4h timeframe direction, prohibiting counter-trend longs regardless of 15m/1h liquidity sweeps.
methodology_flag: Trust lower-timeframe SMC liquidity sweeps less when the 4h trend is clearly bearish.
